_comment: ThreePlayerTicTacToe locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side). Keep every {placeholder} exactly as-is.

_slots.{symbol}: The player's mark, one of A, B or C
_slots.{row}: The board row index of the placed mark
_slots.{col}: The board column index of the placed mark
_slots.{board}: The rendered ASCII board (do not translate)
_slots.{moves}: The comma-separated list of available move tokens like '[4]' (do not translate)

player_prompt.intro:
I ye jokelani {player_id} o kɛ Three-Player Tic Tac Toe.
So bolo ye '{symbol}'.
I ye dɛmɛ sira duguw ko kanburu 5x5 la ye a ye so bolo.
Sira duguw ye kanburu ye sira dugu ko ɲɛgɛn, kɔrɔn, walla kɛlɛkɛlɛ.
Kan i ko sira duguw ye '[4]' la ko kanburu 4.

invalid_move.wrong_format: A tɛ se ka kɛ. I be "[cell]" sɛbɛ yen yɔrɔ min na 0 ye - {max_cell} .
invalid_move.out_of_range: Laa kanburu ye: {cell}. Yeela ye kanburu ye sira dugu ko 0 tan ni {max_cell}.

game_action.placed: Jokelani {player_id} ta a ye so bolo ({symbol}) ko kanburu ({row}, {col}).
